title.en: Metal corrosion and the electrochemical series

summary.en: The electrochemical (activity) series ranks metals by their tendency to lose electrons and oxidise, predicting both which metal in a pair will corrode preferentially when they are in electrical contact and why a more reactive 'sacrificial' metal can protect a less reactive one from corrosion by oxidising in its place.
summary.et: Elektrokeemiline (aktiivsus-) pingerida järjestab metallid nende kalduvuse järgi kaotada elektrone ja oksüdeeruda, ennustades nii seda, milline metall paarist korrodeerub eelistatult, kui nad on elektrilises kontaktis, kui ka seda, miks reaktiivsem 'ohverdatav' metall suudab kaitsta vähem reaktiivset metalli korrosiooni eest, oksüdeerudes tema asemel.
